#!/bin/bash
wump_evidence=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-reclamation
wump_stock=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-7a16547/stock/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl
wump_go=/home/marcus/projects/wump/master/build/checkpoint-runtime-owner/integration/matrix-go
wump_after="$wump_evidence/integration/perl/perl-5.42.2/perl"
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C TZ=UTC
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Refusing timing capture with dirty sources.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if ! git show 91a18ab:bench/operation-matrix-select-current.json > "$wump_evidence/pre-xs-selection.json"; then exit 1; fi
if ! taskset -c 0,2,4,6 perl bench/matrix.pl "$wump_after" "$wump_stock" "$wump_go" --runs 5 --iterations 50000 --jobs 8 --output "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.md" 2> "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.stderr"; then
 printf '%s\n' 'Matrix capture failed.' >&2; exit 1
fi
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-current.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-check.txt"
wump_fresh=$?
perl bench/matrix-check.pl bench/operation-matrix-baseline.json "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-anchor-check.txt"
wump_anchor=$?
perl bench/matrix-check.pl "$wump_evidence/pre-xs-selection.json" "$wump_evidence/matrix-current.json" > "$wump_evidence/matrix-pre-xs-check.txt"
wump_pre_xs=$?
printf 'Previous build gate exit: %s; retained-anchor gate exit: %s; pre-XS selection gate exit: %s\n' "$wump_fresh" "$wump_anchor" "$wump_pre_xs"
if [ "$wump_fresh" -ne 0 ] || [ "$wump_anchor" -ne 0 ] || [ "$wump_pre_xs" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi

lane: Perl for Wump: empty reclamation probes and identity-only package lock operands; separate test-only live cancellation synchronization

machine.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 4750U with Radeon Graphics

matrix_note: Both paired captures use unchanged primary fixtures, Wump.pm, stock/Go binaries, affinity and parameters; each retains 770 samples, 650 successful. Active matrix/integer baselines and legacy checker fixture bytes are unchanged. Exact previous-build and pre-XS reports are embedded; the canonical text file is the retained-anchor check.
validation_note:
Production changes are two separate Perl-for-Wump commits: 66ea4f9 makes the
existing pending retirement count atomic, skips empty registry probes and
avoids locking an empty exception requeue; 904f1d9 fixes direct plain package
scalar lock operands. Source 193914b adds only the live-test cancellation
synchronization fixture. No mutable interpreter/act field is added. No general
XS/compiler gate is relaxed. Five controlled native test-fixture entries are
explicitly admitted before execution for plain reference/ID inputs.

Normal and ASan complete perl-test targets pass on the current production
core. ASan uses full teardown, detect_leaks=0:detect_stack_use_after_return=1,
PERL_SANITIZER=address and matching runtime compile/link flags. Whole-core
TSan scoped suites pass package-lock 4, retirement-parallel 8, memory 54,
hash-key-temporaries 8, local-lookup 8, json-parallel 18, utf8-xs 16,
caller-parallel 12, element-mark-parallel 4, gv-parallel 4 and parallel 56.
Native TSan owned, C/C++ borrowed, eight-executor reclamation, fault/clone and
allocator checks pass; the deliberate Perl_more_bodies race is detected.
LSan/full teardown passes package-lock, retirement, memory and JSON plus the
native owned and memory drivers (C/C++ borrowed, eight-executor reclamation
and fault/clone). Native reclamation preserves 2688 borrowed buffers/slots/
entries across writes, splits 1024 COW aliases and checks quiescent reclamation
and migration. All six runtime archive members and copied core sources are
checked for each variant by the provenance generator.

Stock differentials pass 53 context and 26 legacy assertions. A fresh full
upstream normal run passes 2919 files / 1351358 checks in 323 seconds with
TZ=UTC, unchanged assertions and upstream skips. Parser regeneration matches
Bison 3.8.2; source upgrade/idempotence, opcode and inventory checks pass in
the complete project targets. No complete project TSan or whole-upstream
sanitizer pass is claimed. The separate upstream ithreads clone TSan failure,
MSan locale dependencies and Valgrind tool failures remain open.

Negative controls use the frozen preceding normal interpreter: the final
native idle collector regression aborts at its zero-mutex assertion, and the
final package-lock test fails all four assertions on one/four slots because
GV lookup rejects an operand while its writer is parked. The retirement
stress initially exposed package-counter destruction losses; the independent
parked-writer test makes the cause deterministic. Final tests retain private
and package counter coverage, scalar aliases, explicit publication/read
conflict rejection and exact destruction. Native destructor callbacks queue
new storage while a drain is in progress, preserving the new pin and count.

The standalone in-process memory.t attempt with WUMPPROCS=4 still hits the
existing Test2 INIT string-eval restriction. That failed log is retained;
its supported one-slot run and the separate true-parallel child/native
fixtures pass. Initial parallel test-fixture admission failures are retained
alongside explicit entry audits and the later passing tests.

The original finite live Mojo probe passed 48 one-slot assertions but failed
its four-slot SIGTERM cancellation count. Diagnostic repetitions on current
and preceding interpreters passed; they do not erase that failure. The revised
fixture injects an analyzer only through the test launcher, leaving production
demo code unchanged. Marked jobs repeat real Unicode analysis until their
cancellation callback becomes true. The shutdown test asserts admission and
running state before SIGTERM; the initial finite CPU/reference/responsiveness
workloads are unchanged. Final tests pass 50 assertions each on current one/
four slots and the frozen four-slot interpreter. A finite cancellation control
exits; an always-false callback control times out (expected exit 124), proving
the shutdown probe cannot finish naturally before the signal. Initial failures,
sleep-gate intermediate results and final CPU-gate controls remain in logs.

CPU sampling profiles and three-run/5000-iteration JSON probes are diagnostics.
The latter used source 66ea4f9 before the lock fix; the after binary was then
rebuilt and was not frozen. The final standard matrix uses clean source
193914b, unchanged primary fixtures, Wump.pm, stock/Go controls and CPU mask.
Each paired capture retains 770 observations, 650 successful, with five rotated
runs, 50000 iterations, eight jobs and affinity 0,2,4,6. Exact previous-build,
retained-anchor and pre-XS comparison reports are retained without rebaselining
or retrying a failed gate. The active matrix/integer baseline and legacy
checker fixture contents remain byte-identical to ec80a59. Current performance
status is in the saved reports, not inferred from exploratory probes.

Detailed logs, profiles, captures and separate generated build trees remain
locally under master/build/checkpoint-reclamation. Older snapshots remain in
Git; tracked reports retain one canonical current capture and provenance.

Final gate results: previous build PASS, retained anchor PASS, pre-XS selection
PASS, each at the unchanged +10% budget. JSON work is 48.50/42.35/40.49 us on
one/two/four executors, changing -0.92%/-3.99%/-4.36% versus the preceding
binding capture. Four-slot hashes improve about 20.05%, UTF-8 about 11.37%.
One-slot JSON remains +9.63% work/+9.60% process versus pre-XS selection,
close to its 10% limit; default-anchor JSON is +7.15%/+7.14%. Newly supported
JSON two/four slots in older anchors remain without historical timing gates.
All raw samples and slower rows remain in the current capture; no repeat
capture or baseline replacement was used to obtain these results.
